history.text:
Failure plays an important role in our lives. One of of the most common fears that a human being have is the fear of

not

being

able to succeed or achieve what they want. Failing is not the end, everyone fail at some point: students, professors, presidents, doctors. I believe that we learn from our mistakes and that's how we become stronger.

Although, failing helps us in many ways. As a human being sometimes we need to fail to keep working, for what we want, or need. Nevertheless nothing should stop us specially if is about our goals because if we give up in one failure we won't be able to succeed and become what one day we dreamed.Sometimes we get good and bad experiences from our failure, and that's what help us to succeed.

To begin, failure can teach us a lot from our mistakes, and give us knowledge of what we did wrong and in what we can do better. Being able to know what we did wrong help us succeed even tho we fail on the first try doesn't mean we don't have the opportunity to succeed.Instead, is a good thing that give us an idea in what things we should change to success.

For example, I took Algebra 2 last year and I fail the class and the ESOL that made me very sad because all my friends succeed in the class except for me. This year I'm taking the class again, and even tho is embarrassing to repeat the class I'm doing so much better than last year, and one of the reasons is because I realize what was the big mistake that made fail.This year I have more knowledge in the class which helps to keep my grade up. Having the knowledge from last year is an opportunity to participate in the class, or help others from what I remember.

This shows that, Failure plays in the pursuit of success by giving the opportunity to fix our mistakes. It also teach us to not give up so easily for what we want. In fact failure helps us recognize that we need to work hard to accomplish what we want, and need to

success.

Clearly, There are so many reasons that proves, and shows, and we should believe that sometimes we need to fail to succeed. The article said people who risk to fail are more precise to success. This is an evidence that we need to recognize our mistakes and try harder to get what we want.

Furthermore, Failure led us experiences in where we learn the from our mistakes, and what we should change to not commit the same error. Experiences in failure are helpful specially when we are trying to start rebuilding what we fail. I believe that from those experiences we got better ideas to start over.

For instance, My uncle loves cars he used to work at the dealer fixing cars. He always talk about how hard was for him to learn, and that there was times were he wanted to give up. He spent so much time in the dealer even the weekend

that he learned, so much that he decided to have his own company. The experience of being working on a dealer for so many years and not giving up helped him with the knowledge in how to deals with the business. His company succeed and now is one of the most recognize in the City.

This provides that, experiences can not always be good, but everything depends on us we either decide to work harder and success, or fail. Sometimes we need to fail to success.

Obviously, The key of success is to work hard and give our best to succeed, and achieve our goals no matter how many times we fail. Failure teach us how to recreate better things that way we can have success.

Many of us think that fail is the end of everything and because we don't succeed the first time we are miserable. Instead failure teach us to work hard to get what we want.

Overall, We need to be more patients and never stop. No matter how many times we fail we have to keep working things not always go well in the first time. Try harder and you will have success.

In conclusion, failing happen constantly with everybody almost everyone had to fail to ended up with success like: business,

careers. Success can be hard to achieve, but not impossible. Can be scare to work hard and ended up failing, but failure doesn't determinate succeed. It can be hard not to fail, but that's why we learn from our mistakes, and to not commit the same errors, and become a successful person.

for instance, schools should not be allowed to use cellphones during class because affect the future of students. Sometimes students have the potential to do much better of how they are doing but without the support of teachers, and all school stuff it can be hard. I would like to finish this essay saying that if schools and students work as a team we can do better of what we think.

In conclusion, schools should not be allowed to use cellphones during class because affects the skills of students to learn and the future of students. Shools should make good moves to help students learn in a fun way.

Throughout, the years technology has been getting smarter. A long time ago people didnt have technology like we do now. Being able to do things online for some people is way easier. Sometimes the people are busy and don't have time to go places or don't like going places. Some people dont like making face to face contact. Whenever I go to somewheere like the store , I get so nervous when I go

to the cashier . Some people would say that its better to make contact with others because it makes your confidence go up.

For some people face to face contact is hard .Others have a hard time learning eye contact , it can be pretty hard to learn. With this new technology you can order books , shop , play games online. you can even take online school. if I could i would stay home and do everything online. Some people would argue that it is good to do stuff on your own, but I think i'd rather do it online.

Some people are really good at talking to others. I know many people who are anti-social, they dthe dont like talking much. when people meet me for the first time they always ask why I dont talk to muuch. I always respond with the same answer "i dont like people" . The technology hepls people because it has so many new features . Like you can practicly do anything online. it is such a big help for people who need it.

In my opinion i think it is smart that we can now do anything online. I really dont like talking to people.They make me so nervous . When i get nervous i turn really red, i start to talk really fast

, and my hands get really shakey. My friends tell me i need to talk to more people if i want to help myself out , but i always say no .I would like to take online school or be homeschooled because going to public schools have to many people go to public schools.

In conclusion, throughoutthe years technology has been getting smarter.i think it is a good idea to have many things online for the people who dont like to talk to othe people. I dont like being in contact with other people it makes me feel uncomfortable. Sometimes you just have to live through the feeling of talking to other because you are going to have to do it for the rest of your life.

official_overall_rubric.5: Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.4: Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.3: Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.
official_overall_rubric.2: Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.
official_overall_rubric.1: A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.
